correctness.rationale: No line through P=[0:1:0:0] over any field and the projection-to-[x:t] argument covers all Grassmann points, hence all scheme points. The four projective cubic coefficient equations yield two monic variable eliminations with no denominators. Resultant of u³+9u²+6u+1 and 3u²+6u+2 is -1, certifying origin-only support in every characteristic. Weighted degree12 and degree9 forms therefore form a regular sequence over every field, so the Koszul series gives length27 and socle16; the 2D tangent comes from vanishing linear relations. Proper-and-affine gives finiteness; constant generic and every special-fiber length gives no Z-torsion and finite flat rank27. Exact char3 reduction is (c³,d⁹), all checked in standalone verifier over small fields. No finite testing substitutes for uniform proof.

originality.rationale: The 1998 Brundu–Logar paper and 2015 Alper–Bogart–Velasco source cover the geometric one-line cubic; a 2024 published Mathematics Stack Exchange answer even gives a field-level four-equation Fano chart and a 27-element basis for a projectively equivalent E6 cubic. These are substantial direct precedents, so the raw number 27, unique geometric line, and existence of a nonreduced Fano scheme do NOT count as original. Targeted search and primary comparison did not identify the explicit fixed integral Z[c,d] two-equation scheme, finite-flat proof at 2 and 3, special monomial characteristic-three fiber, and weighted socle-16 description. This is the strictly assessed surviving statement; specialist historical priority remains a risk, not a uniqueness certificate.
residual_risks: The 2024 MathSE answer computes a very closely related Artin ring over a field; a different unpublished/inaccessible treatment may already include the integral and special-characteristic strengthening.
Classical monograph or older case-by-case tables might record the characteristic-three Gorenstein ring in a coordinate change.
The fixed integral model is one arithmetic realization; the theorem does not classify other integral forms or extension of the char0 projective equivalence at primes 2 and 3.

value.rationale: The fixed integral Fano scheme controls arithmetic degeneration of all 27 infinitesimal lines in a classical maximally special cubic. Exact local algebra in characteristic 3, flatness across two and three, and weighted Gorenstein socle are natural structural refinements not implied by generic field-level length27. The problem is literature-led and motivated by the known one-line cubic model, and supplies an actual bad-prime classification rather than a routine numeric re-enumeration.
